notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[h2]Remastered Audio With FMOD[/h2][p]We recently decided to switch to [b]FMOD[/b] for our audio. This redefines the audio experience in the game. There were a lot of sound issues that we wanted to address with so many audio events being played, and the existing solution was not manageable. [b]FMOD[/b] allows us to push the audio quite a bit further, and we have a lot of new ideas planned to take advantage of this in the future. [b]Let us know what you think.[/b] 

  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560934/5600c7df335a23903b84aa4845daee7f149d1554.png"][/img][/p][h2]
Visual FX Improvements[/h2][p]We have been implementing some new animation and FX for specific card selections. We wanted to place more importance of the cards and there abilities. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560934/9e15adf7f69e9a792050fcaef607f3e7d3f53d1a.png"][/img][i]Acquiring an Aspect Card from the Room Hand

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560934/8ec396e905810a200c5f132cce9e7df6f4df5f4b.png"][/img][i]Acquiring a Healing Card from the Room Hand

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560934/271997431e9d7a88859b0bb3d4f99ec9c4cacd17.png"][/img][i]Using an Aspect Card from the Aspect Cards in Hand[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Minor Fixes[/h2][p]On top of everything else we have been actively testing and fixing a lot of minor issues. If you happen to encounter anything during your play-time, please let us know in the Discussion boards. 

 [/p]

notes.title: LOST ALTR Demo Live!
notes.content:
Thanks for checking out LOST ALTR - As a new player we have a few things worth noting if you plan on descending into ALTR. We encourage you to check out the settings page if you have any issues with 'creepy crawlers' or card visibility issues with identifying between suits.

[i]Either from the main menu or in an active Trail you can bring up the Settings Menu.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560934/80c45d1ea847f0a65399f12f3dffcae8d508e566.png[/img]

[i]
Near the bottom you will find some accessibility options. The [b]Card Visibility Coloring [/b]option has several options to choose from. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560934/d4dbfa0384834b819d595ddb2084dd2e4dbfe654.png[/img]

[i]Example of the card coloring with hi-vis. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560934/60828b25563be4407847aef7fc03c377f695b527.png[/img]

[b]We hope you enjoy the demo. Please let us know of any bugs, comments, or general feedback in the community discussion. [/b]

-Happy Delving
